extracted.name: Hazelnut Biscuits
extracted.description: Hi everyone! This recipe tradition in my family gathering, it’s very tasty 😋 I would love to share it with you guys for father’s day especially was my dad’s favorites God bless his soul 🙏 Happy father’s day to all dads in the whole world!
instruction_lines: Mix butter, sugar until smooth to become white and fluffy
Add hazelnut, hazelnut extract and flours with pinch of salt to previous ingredients
Combine by hand until you have nice dough! Then take small amount and make it round as you see in the picture.
Sprinkle sugar in top of all biscuits and bake on preheated oven on 350 F for 10 to 12 minutes maximum and broil until beautiful golden & enjoy your biscuits.
